verdict.rationale: Pipecat's core is a BSD-2 open-source Python framework. A runtime probe confirmed it pip-installs and imports with no key, and the docs say the same bot file is portable to 'most production self-hosting setups'. Community reports confirm running it fully locally with local inference such as Ollama and Whisper. Missing for 10: an in-depth first-party production self-hosting guide in the evidence (the built-in dev runner is explicitly not for production).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: the open-source voice-agent framework is real, pip-installable, and self-hostable
Open source Python framework for building voice and multimodal AI pipelines.
that makes the same bot file portable across the development runner, Pipecat Cloud, and most production self-hosting setups.
Local inference is already supported via Pipecat, you can use ollama or any custom OpenAI endpoint.
